name: direction-aware-completion-successor
title: Make completion-successor validation direction-aware
description: The .mjs preflight completion-successor recovery has no direction awareness: it accepts a shaped archive/journal tail as a completion anchor even when a later commit un-archives the task, producing an unresolvable completion_successor_scope_invalid. The equivalent Python CI classifier was fixed in b3d0cb25; the .mjs path was not.
creator: sdelmas
